summary: The diff implements the four core requirements with good coverage. REQ-1 (authoritative shop status write + query invalidation), REQ-2 (await backend confirmation on all admin mutations), REQ-3 (visible error feedback on failures), and REQ-4 (30-second polling + refetchOnWindowFocus) are all addressed. One minor gap exists: ShopStatusToggle reads the shop status directly from the query with no local optimistic state, so revert-on-error depends on query refetch rather than an explicit rollback. The handleToggleExclusion in AdminProductList silently swallows errors. No significant hallucinated features were found.

missing_requirements.requirement: The ShopStatusToggle reverts to the original value and shows an error message if the backend update fails.
missing_requirements.reason: ShopStatusToggle binds 'checked' directly to shopStatusQuery.data with no local state to revert from. On a failed mutateAsync, the UI depends entirely on the next query refetch to restore the previous value rather than an explicit rollback, meaning the toggle may transiently remain in the wrong state. The AC explicitly requires the component to revert to the original value on failure.

missing_requirements.requirement: All admin mutation onError handlers display a human-readable error string rather than swallowing the error silently.
missing_requirements.reason: In AdminProductList.tsx, the handleToggleExclusion handler has a catch block that explicitly swallows errors with the comment '// silently handled', violating the requirement that no admin mutation silently swallows errors.
